## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmations: (1) broad sector participation in the weekly advance and (2) leadership concentrated across multiple sectors; offset by a MAJOR divergence among Big Tech mega-caps (NVDA, MSFT, META) — Leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 4 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads with MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) and PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +0.31%); Consumer Staples showing strength via MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) and WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +5.50%); Technology strong on net with INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) and QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%) and NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%); Consumer Discretionary mixed with BKNG in CORRECTION (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) and selective winners; Healthcare soft overall with ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) and SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%), MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%), GD RECOVERY (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors reflected in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%), ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%), VST CORRECTION (1W: -5.52% | 1M: +0.86%), SHW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%), BKNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%). Weakness concentrated in select cyclicals and mega-cap tech retracements.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +20.69%), QCOM (1W: +18.92%), GOOGL (1W: +11.99%), MO (1W: +11.47%), GD (1W: +10.42%); MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple mega-caps (NVDA, MSFT, META) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — tactical volatility, not broad trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed — growth leadership but short-term stress: GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) and INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) contrast with NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) and MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +12.20%); watch for resolution of mega-cap divergence.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +9.89%) show participation — sector is supporting risk tone while breadth remains positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Under pressure overall: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) are pockets of strength, while ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) and SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) drag sector tone.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to select Financials and Energy names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND performance (JPM, V, MPC) and selective Tech winners (INTC, QCOM, GOOGL); reduce exposure to names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (NVDA, META, ISRG, FCX) and monitor earnings/news flow. Style: mixed / no clear leadership—trade selectivity until mega-cap divergence resolves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%). BEARISH: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%), META CORRECTION (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy and Financials (both showing weekly strength and confirming leaders). BEARISH: Materials and parts of Healthcare (several names BELOW TREND and negative news flow).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA — fail to reclaim the weekly high would confirm CORRECTION; watch INTC — sustainment above the recent breakout (weekly close) would extend momentum; watch GOOGL — hold this week’s gains to keep ABOVE TREND profile; watch JPM — maintain 1M trend to confirm Financials’ participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GD (+75): General Dynamics RECOVERY (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) — sentiment confirmed by strong weekly move and guidance upgrade. UNH (+60): UnitedHealth ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) — sentiment confirmed. MPC (+60): Marathon Petroleum ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-50): Meta CORRECTION (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) — negative analyst moves align with sharp weekly drop (distribution). SYK (-50): Stryker BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) — sentiment confirmed. SHW (-50): Sherwin-Williams BELOW TREND (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) — news and price weakness aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership as broad sector breadth (8/11) conflicts with a major mega-cap divergence. INTC ABOVE TREND, QCOM ABOVE TREND and GOOGL ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while MPC and UNH also stand out. Key risk: mega-cap tech divergence (NVDA, MSFT, META in CORRECTION) and select negative sentiment in Healthcare/Materials — monitor news-confirmation before adding exposure.
